description: Morphe Patches 1.10.0. Includes the separate Suno timestamped-lyrics exporter with LRC, enhanced LRC, SRT, WebVTT, and JSON output; the Opera GX 56-icon launcher selector; the independently selectable Opera GX raw mod downloader; and the Chrome 150 MonkeyScript manager with contrast-safe Material You, page-capable userscript execution, Greasy Fork/Sleazy Fork installation, and publishing.
